zh-CN.shortDescription: 录音、本地转录、带来源的 AI 纪要与会议助手，集中整理对话和后续工作。
zh-CN.description:
聆记 LingJi 把录音、本地语音转录、会议纪要和原文引用放在同一个工作台，适合会议、访谈、课程和个人语音记录。您可以先记录对话，再核对转录、整理讨论重点，并把后续工作交给已配置的 AI 会议助手。

录音与可核对的纪要
支持麦克风和系统音频录制，随包语音模型可在本机转录。纪要、讨论重点、决策及行动候选保留来源引用，方便回到会议原文核对；人工笔记和修订由您掌握。

AI 会议助手与任务
• 选择会议材料，让助手整理摘要、决策和行动候选，并核对相关原文引用。
• 向工作目录中的会议知识提问，从当前账户可访问的材料中寻找依据。
• 查看后台任务进度、取消任务，并恢复中断的处理；需要补充信息的 Git 归档任务会等待您的回答。
• 配置并授权后，将资料归档到 GitLab 项目或飞书文档，并使用已批准的只读 MCP 工具。

整理与复用
按工作目录管理会议，使用 Markdown 笔记、词表、翻译和已获同意的说话人声音学习，逐步积累可以核对来源的会议知识。

人物与声音
按人物核对声音样本的原文、时间与会议来源，试听留存的原音，并从已确认的发言片段补充样本。跨会议识别须由您明确授权，也可随时停止或删除人物；人工确认的称谓优先。人物和声音仅对当前账户开放。您可以逐人授权会后自动从仍保留原音且经人工确认的发言中补充样本，并随时关闭。

按自己的方式配置
本地转录不要求云端语音账户。AI 纪要、问答及外部工具需自行配置可用模型、服务地址和凭据；第三方服务可能需要独立账户及费用。生成内容和行动候选应经人工核对，外部写入按您配置的授权范围执行。音源能力依赖 Windows 版本与系统权限。

生成内容与反馈
AI 纪要、翻译和问答会根据您的输入动态生成内容，请核对原文并自行判断输出。内容反馈入口：https://github.com/RoyalLiang/LingJi-Meeting-Studio/issues。公开反馈中请勿包含录音、会议原文、密钥或完整分享链接。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
新增会议窗口自动截图并辅助生成纪要。支持在可共享窗口的环境中选择飞书或 Chrome 会议画面。
新增纪要议题内插图，支持随离线 HTML 保存原图，或在确认后导出到飞书云文档。
修复飞书纪要中的重复要点标签。

en-US.shortDescription: Record, transcribe and organize meetings with source-linked notes and an AI assistant.
en-US.description:
LingJi brings recording, local speech transcription, meeting notes and source references into one workspace for meetings, interviews, classes and personal voice notes. Capture the conversation, review the transcript and use the configured AI meeting assistant to organize follow-up work.

Recording and source-linked notes
Record microphone and system audio. Bundled speech models can transcribe on your device. Review meeting summaries, discussion highlights, decisions and draft action items against their source references, while keeping control of your own notes and edits.

AI meeting assistant and tasks
• Select meeting materials for the assistant to summarize, identify decisions and draft action items with references for review.
• Ask questions across meeting knowledge in your workspace, using materials accessible to your account.
• Track or cancel background tasks and recover interrupted processing. Git archiving tasks can pause for clarification when more information is needed.
• With configuration and authorization, archive materials to GitLab or Feishu and use approved read-only MCP tools.

Organize and reuse
Manage meetings by workspace and work with Markdown notes, vocabulary, translation and consent-based speaker voice learning to build meeting knowledge with traceable sources.

People and voices
Review each person's voice samples with transcript text, timestamps, and source meetings. Listen to retained audio and add samples from confirmed speech. Recognition across meetings requires your explicit consent and can be stopped; people can also be deleted. Manually confirmed names take priority. People and voices remain private to the current account. You can opt in per person to add voice samples from manually confirmed speech with retained audio after meetings, and turn it off at any time.

Configure your own services
Local transcription does not require a cloud speech account. AI notes, questions and external tools require configured models, service endpoints and credentials; third-party services may require separate accounts and fees. Review generated content and proposed actions before use. External writes follow the permissions you configure. Audio-source capabilities depend on your Windows version and system permissions.

Generated content and feedback
AI notes, translation and answers are generated dynamically from your input. Review the sources and use your own judgment. Report content concerns at https://github.com/RoyalLiang/LingJi-Meeting-Studio/issues. Do not include recordings, meeting transcripts, credentials or complete share links in public reports.
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added automatic capture of selected Feishu and Chrome meeting windows in environments that support window sharing. Key screenshots can inform meeting minutes.
Added original screenshots alongside related topics in minutes, offline HTML, and confirmed Feishu document exports.
Fixed repeated highlight labels in Feishu meeting minutes.
